Sammaan Capital reported Q2FY27 disbursements of approximately ₹6,000 crore, up from ₹3,875 crore in Q1FY27. Its Assets Under Management grew to over ₹59,000 crore as of September 30, 2026, compared to ₹56,239 crore as of June 30, 2026.

The company added over 30,700 new customers during Q2FY27, compared to 11,867 in Q1FY27, while expanding its distribution footprint with its branch network reaching 245 branches.

news.headline:
India Ratings upgraded Indian Overseas Bank's long-term issuer rating and Basel III Tier 2 bonds to IND AA+/Stable from IND AA/Positive, driven by improved asset quality, stronger core profitability, comfortable capital buffers, controlled slippages, and lower credit costs.

The rating covers Basel III Tier 2 bonds of INR 11.7 billion, though gains are partly offset by a moderating CASA ratio, rising loan-to-deposit ratio, and gold-backed and geographic concentration.

Source: ScoutQuest

news.headline:
AWL Agri Business released its preliminary standalone Q2 FY27 update, reporting 12% YoY volume growth and 24% YoY revenue growth. Its Food & FMCG revenue surged 33% YoY, crossing ₹2,000 crore quarterly for the first time, while Fortune Pulses revenue crossed ₹100 crore.

Segment performance showed Branded Exports volume up 59% YoY, Industry Essentials volume up 25% YoY, and HoReCa up 21% YoY. Additionally, Edible Oil volume grew 3% YoY, GD Foods revenue rose over 30% YoY, and Omkar Chemicals volume gained 16% YoY.

Source: ScoutQuest
